WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
),
store_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT s_store_sk, s_store_id
    FROM store
),
catalog_page_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cp_catalog_page_sk, cp_catalog_page_id
    FROM catalog_page
),
web_site_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT web_site_sk, web_site_id
    FROM web_site
),
store_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sf.store_sk,
           SUM(sf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(sf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(sf.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(sf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ss.ss_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_range dr ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    ) sf
    GROUP BY sf.store_sk
),
ssr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT sd.s_store_id,
           SUM(f.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(f.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(f.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(f.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_facts f
    JOIN store_dim sd ON f.store_sk = sd.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY sd.s_store_id
),
catalog_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT cf.page_sk,
           SUM(cf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(cf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(cf.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(cf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_range dr ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
               cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN date_range dr ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    ) cf
    GROUP BY cf.page_sk
),
csr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pd.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(f.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(f.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(f.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(f.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_facts f
    JOIN catalog_page_dim pd ON f.page_sk = pd.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY pd.cp_catalog_page_id
),
web_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wf.wsr_web_site_sk,
           SUM(wf.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(wf.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(wf.return_amt) AS returns,
           SUM(wf.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ws.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ws.ws_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM web_sales ws
        JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        UNION ALL
        SELECT ws2.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN date_range dr ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_sales ws2
               ON wr.wr_item_sk = ws2.ws_item_sk
              AND wr.wr_order_number = ws2.ws_order_number
    ) wf
    GROUP BY wf.wsr_web_site_sk
),
wsr AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT wd.web_site_id,
           SUM(f.sales) AS sales,
           SUM(f.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(f.returns) AS returns,
           SUM(f.profit_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_facts f
    JOIN web_site_dim wd ON f.wsr_web_site_sk = wd.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY wd.web_site_id
)
SELECT x.channel,
       x.id,
       SUM(x.sales) AS sales,
       SUM(x.returns) AS returns,
       SUM(x.profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           'store' || s_store_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           'catalog_page' || cp_catalog_page_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           'web_site' || web_site_id AS id,
           sales,
           returns,
           (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr
) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (x.channel, x.id)
ORDER BY x.channel, x.id
LIMIT 100
